phases.title: Extract filter helper: move search/category/inStock filtering into a dedicated named function with idiomatic boolean checks
phases.notes: Extracted applyFilters(products, query) helper. Replaced !== undefined checks with idiomatic truthiness for search/category; kept inStock's === undefined guard (needed to distinguish false from absent). All 19 tests pass. Build failure on DEFAULT_LIMIT is pre-existing (noUnusedLocals) and is phase-3 work.

phases.title: Extract sort helper: move all sort branches into a dedicated named function with a consistent structure
phases.notes: Extracted applySort(products, sort) helper using a switch statement for consistent structure. getAllProducts now calls applySort(result, query.sort). All 19 tests pass. Build still fails on DEFAULT_LIMIT (pre-existing noUnusedLocals error, phase-3 work).

phases.title: Remove dead code: delete the unused DEFAULT_LIMIT constant and the unused sanitizeSearch export from productService.ts
phases.notes: Deleted DEFAULT_LIMIT constant and sanitizeSearch export from productService.ts. All 19 tests pass and build is clean (no tsc errors).

phases.title: Verify: run the full test suite and confirm all tests pass with no behaviour regression
phases.notes: All 19 tests pass and build is clean (tsc exits with no errors). No behaviour regression detected.
